title: "Standard Model of particles"
subtitle: "Quarks, leptons and bosons on flip cards"
description: "The Standard Model of particle physics as an interactive table: mass, charge, spin, interactions and discovery. MACEDONIA Laboratory, UMCE."
toc: false
---

The “periodic table” of particle physics: **6 quarks**, **6 leptons**, the **bosons** that carry the interactions and the **Higgs boson**. Each card shows mass, charge and spin, and flipping it reveals its interactions, its discovery and a key fact. At the bottom you can build a hadron out of three quarks.
